evidence: checks/4e6862c442fd_semantic_gate.json: 15/15 witnesses fire and 15/15 rival claims verify
future_check: When adding motifs, run all SEMANTIC_RIVALS against every sliding lesson window and reject any catalog extension that weakens identifiability.
rationale: Random motifs can accidentally be symmetric, positive-quadrant-only, rectangular, or identical under axis swap, leaving screen-translation, bbox-fill, and sign-dropping rivals compatible with a lesson. The finite catalog makes those rival rules observably wrong while retaining canonical motifs.
summary: Use asymmetric signed motifs instead of unconstrained random blobs.

evidence: checks/4e6862c442fd_custom_audit.json: every band has 25/200 draws in each profile
future_check: Keep a downstream gate that starts at sample_index zero and fails if any declared profile disappears across at least eight consecutive seeds.
rationale: The production materializer starts every episode at sample_index zero. A sample-index-only schedule would repeatedly expose only the first four profiles even though arbitrary gate probes could reach all eight. Adding seed to the profile phase preserves deterministic four-pair windows and gives cross-seed coverage of every D4 relation.
summary: Seed-phase the eight-profile schedule so real episodes cover all relations.
